title: Canvas
summary: A pan and zoom ground for design tools: slotted content sits in a world you drag, pinch or Ctrl+wheel around, over an optional grid. pointToWorld and worldToPoint convert units, data-surface-selected nodes get a frame, and the page owns the selection.

props.name: panX
props.description: Where the world origin sits, px from the left.

props.name: panY
props.description: Where the world origin sits, px from the top.

props.name: grid
props.description: The grid spacing in world units (0 none); pointToWorld snaps to it.

props.name: autoGrid
props.description: An adaptive grid: lines at the 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50 ... step that stays 8 to 20 px apart at every zoom, with a stronger line every fifth step or more (colour: --pk-canvas-grid-major). Overrides grid; pointToWorld snaps to the fine step.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit of the rulers and the auto grid. Only labels change: the stored world numbers never do.

props.name: pxPerUnit
props.description: World units per display unit: 0 derives it from unit (mm 96/25.4, in 96, pt 96/72, otherwise 1). Set 1 when the world is already in the unit.

props.name: rulers
props.description: Rulers along the top and left with a pointer readout, in unit; hidden on a phone, thickness --pk-canvas-ruler-size (1.5rem). Loaded on first use.

props.name: wheel
props.description: The plain wheel: auto pans only with focus (else the page scrolls), pan, zoom, or page (never taken). Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel, and pinch, always zoom.

slots.description: The content. Add data-surface-selected to a descendant to frame it.

events.name: pk-canvas-pick
events.description: A press without movement: the deepest node under it, or null on bare ground; additive with Shift, Ctrl or Cmd.

events.name: pk-canvas-key
events.description: Delete, Escape or Shift with an arrow on the focused surface, for the page to act on.

parts.name: status
parts.description: The live region that announces the zoom

parts.name: ruler
parts.description: One ruler strip, data-axis x or y

parts.name: ruler-readout
parts.description: The pointer position in the unit

methods.name: pointToWorld(clientX, clientY)
methods.description: Returns { x, y } world units for a client point, grid-snapped

methods.name: worldToPoint(x, y)
methods.description: Returns { x, y } in client pixels for a world point

methods.name: zoomToFit(rect?)
methods.description: Fits a world rect { x, y, w, h }, or the slotted content, in the surface

methods.name: zoomTo(zoom, anchor?)
methods.description: Zooms around a surface pixel { x, y } (default the middle)

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Back to zoom 1 at the origin

a11y: A labelled group and one tab stop. Arrows pan (mirrored in right-to-left), + and - zoom, 0 resets, 1 or Home fits; Delete, Escape and Shift+arrow reach the page. Zoom changes are announced; the plain wheel is the page's until focus.
mobile: One finger pans, two pinch, a tap picks; the toolbar folds to icons with 44px targets.
